slides.title: New step: letting go
slides.text: You already open your day with an intention and close it with gratitude. Now let's learn to let go.

slides.title: What banishing is
slides.text: Choosing what you won't carry today: a worry, a habit, a thought that keeps coming back.

slides.title: How to do it
slides.text: Name what you want to release. Take three deep breaths and picture it leaving with the air. Then mark it as done.

slides.title: Morning and night
slides.text: In the morning, let go of what would get in the way of your day. At night, of what weighed on you.

slides.title: Try it today
slides.text: A banishing takes a minute. Your first one can be right now.

slides.title: New step: rituals
slides.text: A ritual is a simple gesture repeated with intention: lighting a candle, making tea, stretching when you wake up.

slides.title: Morning ritual
slides.text: Pick something short you can repeat every day. Repetition matters more than length.

slides.title: Night ritual
slides.text: A gesture that tells your body the day is over: dimming the lights, writing, breathing.

slides.title: How you woke up
slides.text: From now on you also log how you woke up and whether you got the sleep you wanted. Over time, patterns show up.

slides.title: With care
slides.text: Never leave a candle unattended, and don't swallow anything. Magic is care.

slides.title: Intentions by area
slides.text: Your Week now also opens intentions by area: Magic, Personal, Leisure, Work and Study.

slides.title: Try it today
slides.text: Choose your morning ritual and do it once. Tomorrow it gets easier.

slides.title: New step: your body
slides.text: Your body is where your magic happens. Caring for it is practice too.

slides.title: Three kinds of care
slides.text: Water, stretching and movement. Tick them off through the day as you go.

slides.title: No performance goals
slides.text: What counts here is care, not hitting numbers.

slides.title: Your Body Focus
slides.text: Tap "My body focus" to build workouts, log sets and follow your progress.

slides.title: Try it today
slides.text: A glass of water already counts. Start with whatever you can.

slides.title: The last step: reflecting
slides.text: Closing your day with awareness is what turns a routine into a path.

slides.title: Final reflection
slides.text: What did today teach you? Two lines are enough.

slides.title: Day in a sentence
slides.text: A line you'll enjoy rereading a year from now.

slides.title: The whole method
slides.text: Intention, letting go, ritual, body, gratitude and reflection. The whole journal is yours now.

slides.title: Try it today
slides.text: Close today with your first reflection.

slides.title: You closed your first week
slides.text: Now you can look further ahead.

slides.title: The Month
slides.text: Intention, goals by area, moons and rituals for the month.

slides.title: The Year
slides.text: Your word for the year and what you want to build.

slides.title: Try it
slides.text: Start with this month: one intention and two goals are enough.
